fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must be valid for the planned length of your stay.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe ser válido durante toda la duración prevista de tu estancia.
entry.quote: Your passport must be valid for the planned length of your stay.

entry.en: Visitors must be able to show an onward or return ticket to enter the country.
entry.es: Los visitantes deben poder mostrar un billete de continuación o de vuelta para entrar al país.
entry.quote: Visitors must be able to show an onward or return ticket in order to enter the country.

entry.en: All travellers must fill in an immigration and customs form online before arriving.
entry.es: Todos los viajeros deben completar en línea un formulario de inmigración y aduanas antes de llegar.
entry.quote: All travellers must fill in an immigration and customs form online before they arrive.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you come from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se llega desde un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: All passengers aged 2 and older must pay a departure tax of 55 Barbados dollars (27.50 US dollars).
entry.es: Todos los pasajeros de 2 años o más deben pagar una tasa de salida de 55 dólares de Barbados (27,50 dólares estadounidenses).
entry.quote: All passengers aged 2 years and older must pay a departure tax of 55 Barbados dollars (27.50 US dollars).

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Debes declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: There has been an increase in gang-related murders involving guns.
safety.es: Ha aumentado el número de asesinatos con armas de fuego relacionados con bandas.
safety.quote: There has been an increase in gang-related murders involving guns.

safety.en: The FCDO advises avoiding isolated areas, including beaches, particularly after dark.
safety.es: El FCDO aconseja evitar zonas aisladas, incluidas las playas, sobre todo después del anochecer.
safety.quote: avoid isolated areas, including beaches, particularly after dark

safety.en: Take great care when swimming, as currents can be deceptively strong, including on some popular south and west coast beaches.
safety.es: Ten mucho cuidado al nadar, pues las corrientes pueden ser engañosamente fuertes, incluso en algunas playas populares de las costas sur y oeste.
safety.quote: Always take great care when swimming. Currents can be deceptively strong, including on some of the popular beaches on the south and west coasts.

safety.en: The hurricane season normally runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes suele ir de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season normally runs from June to November.

safety.en: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to wear camouflage clothing.
safety.es: Es ilegal que cualquier persona, incluidos los niños, vista ropa de camuflaje.
safety.quote: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to wear camouflage clothing.

safety.en: The most common crimes against tourists include taxi fraud, robbery and short-changing.
safety.es: Los delitos más comunes contra turistas incluyen el fraude con taxis, el robo y el engaño con el cambio.
safety.quote: The most common crimes against tourists include taxi fraud, robbery, and short-changing

health.en: The emergency medical number is 511; ask for an ambulance.
health.es: El número de emergencias médicas es el 511; pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 511 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Queen Elizabeth Hospital can cope with many treatments, but serious cases may need emergency evacuation.
health.es: El Queen Elizabeth Hospital puede atender muchos tipos de tratamiento, pero los casos graves pueden requerir evacuación de emergencia.
health.quote: The Barbados healthcare system is not as extensive as the UK. Queen Elizabeth Hospital can cope with many types of treatment, but serious cases may need emergency evacuation.

health.en: Medical treatment in Barbados can be expensive.
health.es: El tratamiento médico en Barbados puede ser caro.
health.quote: Medical treatment in Barbados can be expensive.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable.
health.quote: Drink plenty of water (the tap water is safe)

health.en: Mosquitoes are more of a nuisance than a danger, and it is very rare for them to carry serious tropical disease such as malaria.
health.es: Los mosquitos son más una molestia que un peligro, y es muy raro que transmitan enfermedades tropicales graves como la malaria.
health.quote: Mosquitoes are more of a nuisance than a danger: it's very rare for them to carry serious tropical disease such as malaria.

health.en: You can burn very easily even if it is cloudy and the sea breeze keeps you cool.
health.es: Puedes quemarte con mucha facilidad incluso si está nublado y la brisa marina te refresca.
health.quote: you can burn very easily even if it's cloudy and the sea breeze is keeping you cool

help.en: Emergency numbers in Barbados are 511 for ambulance, 311 for fire and 211 for police.
help.es: Los números de emergencia en Barbados son el 511 (ambulancia), el 311 (bomberos) y el 211 (policía).

getting_in.en: The main way in and out of Barbados is by air, through Grantley Adams Airport in Bridgetown.
getting_in.es: La principal vía de entrada y salida de Barbados es aérea, por el aeropuerto Grantley Adams de Bridgetown.
getting_in.quote: Bridgetown Grantley Adams Airport (BGI  IATA). By air is the main way in and out of Barbados

getting_in.en: The airport is 8 miles east of downtown, with public buses and minibuses from a stop just outside.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto está a 8 millas al este del centro, con autobuses públicos y minibuses desde una parada justo afuera.
getting_in.quote: The airport is 8 miles east of downtown. Public buses and minibuses run from a stop just outside the airport.

getting_in.en: There are no ferries between Barbados and the other Caribbean islands.
getting_in.es: No hay ferris entre Barbados y las demás islas del Caribe.
getting_in.quote: There are no ferries between Barbados and the other Caribbean islands.

getting_in.en: You have to fill in a landing card for immigration and keep the counterfoil for departure.
getting_in.es: Hay que rellenar una tarjeta de llegada para inmigración y conservar el resguardo para la salida.
getting_in.quote: You have to fill in a landing card for immigration, and must keep the counterfoil for departure.

getting_in.en: Many cruise ships dock in Bridgetown deep water harbour.
getting_in.es: Muchos cruceros atracan en el puerto de aguas profundas de Bridgetown.
getting_in.quote: Many cruise ships dock in Bridgetown deep water harbour

getting_around.en: Traffic drives on the left, and the bus system is extensive, cheap and fast on the main route.
getting_around.es: Se conduce por la izquierda, y el sistema de autobuses es extenso, barato y rápido en la ruta principal.
getting_around.quote: Drive on the left. The bus system is extensive, cheap and fast if you are headed somewhere on the main route

getting_around.en: Buses charge the same flat fare of B$3.50 in 2026, in B$ or US$, but BTB buses do not give change.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses cobran la misma tarifa fija de B$3,50 en 2026, en B$ o US$, pero los de BTB no dan cambio.
getting_around.quote: All charge the same flat fare for any journey: in 2026 it's B$3.50. They accept either B$ or US$, but BTB buses don't give change.

getting_around.en: Transport Board buses are blue and quiet, while private yellow buses play loud music and white mini-vans are usually cramped.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses de la Junta de Transporte son azules y tranquilos, mientras que los amarillos privados ponen música muy alta y las minivans blancas suelen ir apretadas.
getting_around.quote: Buses run by the Barbados Transport Board are blue, and quiet. Private operators include the yellow buses, which play very loud music, and private white mini-vans, which are usually cramped and crowded.

getting_around.en: Taxis are plentiful and reasonably priced, but they have no meters, so negotiate the price first.
getting_around.es: Hay muchos taxis a precios razonables, pero no tienen taxímetro, así que negocia el precio antes de empezar.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are plentiful and prices are reasonable. They don't use meters, so negotiate the price before you start.

getting_around.en: Renting a car is expensive, and island roads are narrow and twisty with poor sight-lines and unexpected bumps.
getting_around.es: Alquilar un coche es caro, y las carreteras de la isla son estrechas y sinuosas, con poca visibilidad y baches inesperados.
getting_around.quote: Renting a car is expensive. Island roads are narrow and twisty with poor sight-lines and unexpected bumps.

money.en: The local currency is the Bajan dollar (BBD), usually written B$ on local signage.
money.es: La moneda local es el dólar de Barbados (BBD), que suele escribirse B$ en los letreros locales.
money.quote: The local currency is the Bajan dollar, officially denoted as "Bds$" (ISO code: BBD) but usually just as B$ on local signage

money.en: US dollars are accepted almost everywhere at a fixed 2 to 1 rate, but hotels may charge an extra 5% or so.
money.es: Los dólares estadounidenses se aceptan casi en todas partes a una tasa fija de 2 a 1, pero los hoteles pueden cobrar un 5% extra.
money.quote: US dollars are accepted in almost all shops and restaurants. The exchange rate is fixed at 2 Bajan dollars to the US dollar, but hotels may scalp you for an extra 5% or so.

money.en: Taxi drivers do not always accept card payments, so carry cash.
money.es: Los taxistas no siempre aceptan pagos con tarjeta, así que lleva efectivo.
money.quote: Drivers do not always accept card payments, so carry cash with you.

money.en: With street vendors you are advised to haggle vigorously, down to about a third of the original price.
money.es: Con los vendedores ambulantes se aconseja regatear con insistencia, hasta cerca de un tercio del precio inicial.
money.quote: Barbados has a great variety of street vendors. Haggle vigorously. Don't stop until you are at about a third of the original price.

money.en: On duty-free items the price tag should state DF and the amount in US$ or B$.
money.es: En los artículos libres de impuestos la etiqueta debe indicar DF y el importe en US$ o B$.
money.quote: the price tag should state DF and the amount in US$ or B$.

etiquette.en: Bajans tend to dress conservatively away from the beach, and a bikini will not be appreciated in town or in church.
etiquette.es: Los barbadenses tienden a vestir de forma conservadora fuera de la playa, y un bikini no se aprecia en la ciudad ni en la iglesia.
etiquette.quote: Bajans are fun-loving yet tend to dress conservatively when not on the beach. A bikini will not be appreciated in town and certainly not in church.

etiquette.en: Bajans appreciate courteous manners, and saying Good morning, even to strangers, goes a long way to earning respect.
etiquette.es: Los barbadenses aprecian los buenos modales, y decir buenos días, incluso a desconocidos, ayuda mucho a ganarse su respeto.
etiquette.quote: They appreciate courteous manners, and saying "Good morning" to them, even strangers, goes a long way to earning their respect.

etiquette.en: The N word is a no-no, and informal terms like B and dawg are for friends, not strangers.
etiquette.es: La palabra con N está prohibida, y términos informales como B y dawg son para amigos, no para desconocidos.
etiquette.quote: The "N" word is a no-no, but informal terms such as "B" (short for "bro") and "dawg" are used among friends. Strangers shouldn't use them.

connectivity.en: You can buy a local SIM card at the airport, cruise terminal or tourist strips, and mobile data is expensive.
connectivity.es: Puedes comprar una SIM local en el aeropuerto, la terminal de cruceros o las zonas turísticas, y los datos móviles son caros.
connectivity.quote: You can buy a local SIM card at the airport, cruise ship terminal, or any tourist strip. Mobile data is expensive.

connectivity.en: There are two mobile carriers, Flow (formerly Lime) and Digicel.
connectivity.es: Hay dos operadores móviles, Flow (antes Lime) y Digicel.
connectivity.quote: There are two mobile carriers, Flow (formerly Lime) and Digicel.

connectivity.en: Using your own mobile in Barbados will incur international charges.
connectivity.es: Usar tu móvil en Barbados implicará cargos internacionales.
connectivity.quote: Using your mobile in Barbados will hit you with international charges.

connectivity.en: Flow is rolling out 5G across the island during 2026.
connectivity.es: Flow está desplegando el 5G en toda la isla durante 2026.
connectivity.quote: Flow are rolling out 5G across the island during 2026.
